scorecard.rationale: A controlled ground-cinnamon crossover outside Parkinson disease had no clear daily stool-frequency contrast. Human cassia water-extract findings concern model-relevant transit during diarrhea. Extract experiments in constipated and diarrheal rats move pellet frequency in different directions under different conditions. The symptom-severity direction remains unresolved. The 2017 iRBD study used cinnamon as one odor in an aggregate smell-identification test. It assessed baseline constipation separately. The diagnostic setting supplies no constipation comparison attributed to cinnamon.
